   122→    def _handle_hda_promote_parm(self, payload: Dict) -> Dict:
   123→        """Promote an internal node parameter to the HDA interface.
   124→
   125→        Uses hou.HDADefinition.setParmTemplateGroup() to modify the HDA's
   126→        parameter interface. Creates channel references from the promoted
   127→        parameter to the internal node parameter.
   128→
   129→        Idempotent: re-promoting the same parameter updates rather than duplicates.
   130→
   131→        Payload:
   132→            hda_path (str, required): Path to the HDA instance node.
   133→            internal_node (str, required): Relative path to internal node (e.g. 'scatter1').
   134→            parm_name (str, required): Parameter name on the internal node.
   135→            label (str): Optional label override for the promoted parameter.
   136→            folder (str): Optional folder/tab name to place the parameter in.
   137→            callback (str): Optional Python callback script.
   138→            conditions (dict): Optional visibility conditions.
   139→        """
   140→        if not HOU_AVAILABLE:
   141→            raise RuntimeError(_HOUDINI_UNAVAILABLE)
   142→
   143→        hda_path = resolve_param(payload, "hda_path")
   144→        internal_node_name = resolve_param(payload, "internal_node")
   145→        parm_name = resolve_param(payload, "parm_name")
   146→        label = resolve_param_with_default(payload, "label", None)
   147→        folder = resolve_param_with_default(payload, "folder", None)
   148→        callback = resolve_param_with_default(payload, "callback", None)
   149→        conditions = resolve_param_with_default(payload, "conditions", None)
   150→
   151→        from .main_thread import run_on_main
   152→
   153→        def _on_main():
   154→            hda_node = hou.node(hda_path)
   155→            if hda_node is None:
   156→                raise ValueError(
   157→                    f"Couldn't find HDA node at {hda_path} -- "
   158→                    "make sure the path points to an existing HDA instance"
   159→                )
   160→
   161→            definition = hda_node.type().definition()
   162→            if definition is None:
   163→                raise ValueError(
   164→                    f"The node at {hda_path} doesn't appear to be an HDA -- "
   165→                    "it has no HDA definition attached"
   166→                )
   167→
   168→            # Find the internal node
   169→            internal_node = hda_node.node(internal_node_name)
   170→            if internal_node is None:
   171→                raise ValueError(
   172→                    f"Couldn't find internal node '{internal_node_name}' inside "
   173→                    f"{hda_path} -- check the relative path"
   174→                )
   175→
   176→            # Find the parameter on the internal node
   177→            source_parm = internal_node.parm(parm_name)
   178→            if source_parm is None:
   179→                raise ValueError(
   180→                    f"Couldn't find parameter '{parm_name}' on "
   181→                    f"{internal_node.path()} -- check the parameter name"
   182→                )
   183→
   184→            # Get the parameter template from the source
   185→            source_template = source_parm.parmTemplate()
   186→
   187→            # Build the promoted parameter template
   188→            promoted_name = f"{internal_node_name}_{parm_name}"
   189→            promoted_label = label or source_template.label()
   190→
   191→            # Clone the template with the new name
   192→            promoted_template = source_template.clone()
   193→            promoted_template.setName(promoted_name)
   194→            promoted_template.setLabel(promoted_label)
   195→
   196→            if callback:
   197→                promoted_template.setScriptCallback(callback)
   198→                promoted_template.setScriptCallbackLanguage(
   199→                    hou.scriptLanguage.Python
   200→                )
   201→
   202→            # Get the current parm template group
   203→            ptg = definition.parmTemplateGroup()
   204→
   205→            # Check for idempotent update -- remove existing if present
   206→            existing = ptg.find(promoted_name)
   207→            if existing is not None:
   208→                ptg.remove(promoted_name)
   209→
   210→            # Add to folder if specified, otherwise add to root
   211→            if folder:
   212→                folder_template = ptg.findFolder(folder)
   213→                if folder_template is None:
   214→                    # Create the folder
   215→                    new_folder = hou.FolderParmTemplate(
   216→                        folder.lower().replace(" ", "_"),
   217→                        folder,
   218→                    )
   219→                    new_folder.addParmTemplate(promoted_template)
   220→                    ptg.append(new_folder)
   221→                else:
   222→                    ptg.appendToFolder(folder_template, promoted_template)
   223→            else:
   224→                ptg.append(promoted_template)
   225→
   226→            # Apply the updated template group
   227→            definition.setParmTemplateGroup(ptg)
   228→
   229→            # Create channel reference from promoted parm to internal parm
   230→            promoted_parm = hda_node.parm(promoted_name)
   231→            if promoted_parm is not None:
   232→                source_parm.set(
   233→                    promoted_parm,
   234→                    language=hou.exprLanguage.Hscript,
   235→                    follow_parm_reference=False,
   236→                )
   237→
   238→            return {
   239→                "status": "ok",
   240→                "promoted_parm": promoted_name,
   241→                "folder": folder or "(root)",
   242→            }
   243→
   244→        return run_on_main(_on_main)

   246→    def _handle_hda_set_help(self, payload: Dict) -> Dict:
   247→        """Set help documentation on an HDA.
   248→
   249→        Generates Houdini wiki markup help content from structured inputs
   250→        and stores it via HDA definition sections.
   251→
   252→        Payload:
   253→            hda_path (str, required): Path to the HDA instance node.
   254→            summary (str): Short summary for the HDA.
   255→            description (str): Full description (supports Houdini wiki markup).

   286→
   287→            # Set the comment/summary

   290→
   291→            # Build help card content in Houdini wiki markup

   293→
   294→            if summary:

   297→
   298→            if description:

   305→            if author:

   308→
   309→            if parameters_help and isinstance(parameters_help, dict):
   310→                help_lines.append("@parameters")
   311→                help_lines.append("")
   312→                for pname, phelp in sorted(parameters_help.items()):

   338→    def _handle_hda_package(self, payload: Dict) -> Dict:
   339→        """High-level orchestrator: create subnet, build HDA, promote params, set help.
   340→
   341→        Runs the entire pipeline inside a single undo group for atomic rollback
   342→        on failure. This is the go-to tool for creating HDAs from a description.
   343→
   344→        Payload:
   345→            description (str, required): What the HDA should do.
   346→            name (str, required): Operator name (e.g. 'scatter_on_surface').
   347→            category (str, required): Node category (Sop, Object, Driver, Lop, Top).
   348→            save_path (str, required): File path to save the .hda file.
   349→            inputs (list): List of input descriptions (optional).
   350→            promoted_parms (list): List of {node, parm, label} dicts (optional).
   351→        """
   352→        if not HOU_AVAILABLE:
   353→            raise RuntimeError(_HOUDINI_UNAVAILABLE)
   354→

   356→        name = resolve_param(payload, "name")
   357→        category = resolve_param(payload, "category")
   358→        save_path = resolve_param(payload, "save_path")
   359→        inputs = resolve_param_with_default(payload, "inputs", None) or []
   360→        promoted_parms = resolve_param_with_default(payload, "promoted_parms", None) or []
   361→        nodes = resolve_param_with_default(payload, "nodes", None) or []
   362→        connections = resolve_param_with_default(payload, "connections", None) or []
   363→

   367→                f"'{category}' isn't a valid HDA category -- "
   368→                f"use one of: {', '.join(sorted(_VALID_CATEGORIES))}"

   373→        def _on_main():

   375→            category_parents = {
   376→                "Sop": "/obj",
   377→                "Object": "/obj",
   378→                "Driver": "/out",
   379→                "Lop": "/stage",
   380→                "Top": "/obj",

1→# Spec: HDA Scaffolding Recipe for Synapse
     2→
     3→**Status**: Ready for implementation
     4→**Target**: `python/synapse/routing/recipes.py` -> `RecipeRegistry._register_builtins()`
     5→**Category**: `pipeline`

     9→
    10→## Overview
    11→
    12→A Synapse recipe that scaffolds a complete HDA (Houdini Digital Asset) from a natural language description. Creates the subnet structure, wires I/O, creates the HDA definition, adds standard parameters, and saves to the project's `otls/` directory.
    13→
    14→This is a **scaffold** -- it creates the structural shell with proper conventions. The artist (or higher-tier Synapse operations) fills in the internal logic.
    15→
    16→## Why This Matters
    17→
    18→- **HDA Architect** (competitor) generates HDAs from prompts using Gemini. Synapse currently has no HDA creation recipe.
    19→- HDAs are the standard packaging format for reusable tools in Houdini. Every studio pipeline depends on them.
    20→- Scaffolding removes the tedious boilerplate: subnet creation, I/O wiring, HDA definition, namespace, version, help text, icon, category.
    21→
    22→## Trigger Patterns
    23→
    24→```python
    25→triggers=[
    26→    r"^(?:create|make|build|scaffold)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(?:hda|digital asset|otl)(?:\s+(?:called|named)\s+(?P<name>[\w]+))?(?:\s+(?:for|that|to|which)\s+(?P<description>.+))?$",
    27→    r"^(?:new|setup)\s+(?:hda|digital asset)(?:\s+(?P<name>[\w]+))?(?:\s+(?:for|that|to|which)\s+(?P<description>.+))?$",
    28→    r"^hda\s+scaffold(?:\s+(?P<name>[\w]+))?(?:\s+(?P<description>.+))?$",
    29→],
    30→parameters=["name", "description"],

    35→- `"scaffold hda debris_sim"` -> name=`debris_sim`, description=``

## 10. Key Gotchas & Design Decisions

1. **Nodes/Connections spec in hda_package**: Uses `__input0` convention for subnet inputs. This enables structured generation ("if description matches 'noise deformer', use nodes=[{type:'mountain'}, {type:'wrangle'}], connections=[[__input0, mountain, 0], [mountain, wrangle, 0], [wrangle, OUT, 0]]")

2. **Validation as warnings**: Cook errors and missing promoted parms are captured as warnings, not exceptions. Allows partial HDAs to complete (e.g., incomplete internal nodes still produce a valid HDA structure)

3. **Idempotency in promote_parm**: Re-promoting the same parameter removes old and re-adds. Safe for re-runs.

4. **Author=synapse metadata**: hda_list filters only HDAs with this metadata. Allows Synapse to manage its own asset library separately from user/studio HDAs.
